steps.u: Write unit tests for slugify() in src/slug.ts. It should handle accents, spaces, emoji, and an empty string.

i.content:
describe('slugify', () => {
  it('strips accents', () => expect(slugify('Crème Brûlée')).toBe('creme-brulee'))
  it('collapses spaces', () => expect(slugify('a   b')).toBe('a-b'))
  it('drops emoji', () => expect(slugify('go 🚀 now')).toBe('go-now'))
  it('returns empty for empty', () => expect(slugify('')).toBe(''))
  it('trims dashes', () => expect(slugify('--x--')).toBe('x'))
})

reference.summary: Wrote five unit tests for a slugify function covering accents, repeated spaces, emoji, the empty string and leading or trailing dashes; all pass.
facts: accents, spaces, emoji, empty string, trimmed dashes
